Owed: the at-tier review this Tier S rules-text PR needs before the queue (`check-governed-merges --pr 34266`: Tier S, `.claude/**` only, 2 files, +6/−6). Card #34153 (p2, maintainer-directed, filing gate ③), claim 6905925623, surface widened 6906014953, os-dev-report 6906225912.

Seat's L1 read on this head, for the reviewer to confirm or overturn:
- The standard (`triage-duties.md`, the continuation lines after 「缺 `reach:` … 定 p3」) copies the card's close list (three items, every example) and keep list (five items) with nothing added or dropped. The old 「不因此关卡」, which contradicts the standard, is gone. Please judge two things: whether the placement makes the standard read as a rule for every p3 first touch, and not only for a card missing `reach:`; and the dev's open question ①, where "ADR/jsdoc wording" in the close list meets the ADR record cards that AGENTS.md ruling 6797014134 asks for. The dev reads those as kept under "maintainer-directed".
- `filing-gate.md`: one new line says a nit or out-of-scope finding that meets the p3 close criteria goes only into the PR's record, never a card, and that the ruling-B per-PR card and the area loose-ends card take only items that pass the keep criteria, with no card when the list is empty. Please check that it reads with the unchanged next line (「p3 文案/文档 nit 入该区 loose ends 卡」). Published docs and skills text are on the keep list, so the seat reads no conflict.
- The lines are paid by four deletions the seat approved:
  - `triage-duties` old line 10 (cloud fallback). Its home is `lanes/cloud.md` line 27, nearly word for word.
  - Old line 57 (the (c) metadata definition). Its home is `os-dev.md` line 50. Class (c) itself stays at line 52.
  - Old line 37 (`Suggested-grade:` is input). Its home is `execution-duties.md` lines 63 and 130. Line 130 keeps 「不采纳给理由」, so open question ② has its answer.
  - `filing-gate` old line 13 (the two forms of `reach:`). Its home is `os-dev.md` line 47. ⚠️ The filing gate keeps only the word `reach:`; the definition is no longer in `pm-dispatch/**`. Please judge whether that payer is acceptable or should be swapped.
- No security-discipline line is touched. Line counts are 104 and 82, unchanged. New lines are at most 120 bytes.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a7ccc0ee7b39d03dde9c135a7091faa4e69cb2c6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + none (no file in the diff implements or enforces them; read, not reviewed: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `references/lanes/cloud.md`, `references/execution-duties.md`, `references/contract-review.md`, `references/security-findings.md`, `SKILL.md`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`)

Read at 2026-11-16T03:21Z. First review of this head; claim: comment 6906283470; lane request 6906247948 on mailbox #33873 (the lane's at-tier reviewer was unavailable). Independence: implemented in an os-steve project thread, dispatched by domain:skills#2 (os-steve); reviewed by os-tesla, who neither dispatched nor implemented it.

### ① Derived judgments

- Diff read whole at the head: one commit on `35cc66386`, two files, +6/−6, line counts 104 and 82 unchanged. `main` has moved since, with no change to either file or to any of the four claimed homes.
- Fidelity to the card body, clause by clause: holds. Close side: no customer or user effect with all four examples (pins only, ADR or jsdoc wording, internal refactors, test-title rewording); stale readings, superseded or delivered; corners no user is measured reaching with both examples; `not_planned`, each card with its own reason. Keep side: all five items. Nothing added, nothing dropped.
- Fidelity to the maintainer's own words: not checkable from the card, its comments or the PR. The only maintainer words in them are 「剩下的p3你都按照这个标准完整的审核一遍吧」. The clause text is triage's rendering ("the standard, as applied"), and the card attributes to the maintainer only the agreement to close what had no customer effect. See M3.
- The four deleted lines, each checked with `git grep` at the head across `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md` and `scripts/pm`:
  - `triage-duties` old 10 (cloud fallback, 4 h): `lanes/cloud.md:27` carries the same rule, including that triage does not write the labels. Home holds. See N1.
  - `triage-duties` old 57 (the (c) metadata definition): `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:50` carries it and says more (a named producer). Home holds. See N2.
  - `triage-duties` old 37 (`Suggested-grade:` is input, confirm or re-rule, give a reason when not adopting): no home. `execution-duties.md:63` is the writer's rule only. `execution-duties.md:130` is about triage's own suggestion line read by the executing seat (the `Size/model suggestion:` line of `triage-duties.md:73`), the opposite direction; it does not cover this line, so the handoff's reading that line 130 answers the dev's open question does not hold. `Suggested-grade` now occurs once in the repository. See M1.
  - `filing-gate` old 13 (the two forms of `reach:`): the only definition left is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:47`. Inside `pm-dispatch/**` the key is now required (`filing-gate.md:9`), excepted (`:13`), gated (`triage-duties.md:55`) and repaired (`execution-duties.md:64`) with no definition and no pointer. See M2.
- Security items: the keep side names them, `triage-duties.md:81` keeps security cards outside triage's close power and `security-findings.md:52` forbids a seat closing one. No security-discipline line was a payer or was edited. One wording gap at the rule layer, S3(d).

### ② Semver level

None. Internal rules text under `.claude/**`; no package, no published surface, no changeset owed (`skip-changeset`). CI on this head: 48 check-runs, all completed, none failed or cancelled (the rest skipped by path); `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `PR-body guards` are green. Nothing is still running. The PR is a draft, mergeable state clean.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Human floor. `triage-duties.md:92` lists a card's fate (closing as not planned) and `:93` lists rules, standing orders and exceptions as the maintainer's; `:96` item ⑥ sends anything against an existing ruling to the maintainer. This PR writes a standing close authority and narrows ruling B (ruling of record 6891082225, "one checklist card per reviewed PR"). The quoted order covers one pass over the p3 cards open that day. See M3.
- Surface. The claim named the grading block and the ruling-B lines; the seat widened it to four payer lines elsewhere (comment 6906014953). Two of those four removed a rule or a definition from where its reader looks (M1, M2). A card that asks for three additions does not order a deletion.
- Security: rule layer only, nothing mechanism-level in this diff. See S3(d).

### ④ Design judgment

M1 (must-fix) — `triage-duties.md` old line 37 is deleted with no home. The reader-side rule for a lane's `Suggested-grade:` line (input, not a grade; confirm or re-rule; give a reason when not adopting) exists nowhere at this head. The PR body calls the home weak; it is absent. Restore the line and pay with a line that has a true duplicate, or carry the reader clause on `execution-duties.md:63` if that file's budget allows. First finding on this PR; continues no prior id.

M2 (must-fix) — `filing-gate.md` old line 13 is the wrong payer. It was the skill's only definition of `reach:`, and the same PR adds a close clause that turns on it (「无用户实测可达的边角」). A triage seat, or a reviewer applying new line 34, now decides a close on "measured reaching" with the definition of a measured reach living only in the dev agent's file, which neither rules file points to. New line 13 also reads as two exceptions to a rule the file no longer states. Swap the payer, or keep the definition in one place inside the skill and point to it from both files. Continues no prior id.

M3 (must-fix) — the third close clause is unsourced and cuts against a verbatim maintainer ruling in the same file, with no precedence stated. `filing-gate.md` grading rules 2 and 3 (the maintainer's 2026-11-13 ruling, quoted in the ratchet ledger: 「只是读代码得出的最高 p2。这个没必要吧，我们的客户不多。」 and 「不需要限额，也不需要自动关。其他同意。」) say there is no second tier for "no current user" and no evidence cap on a finding read from code with its mechanism written; lines 75–76 say "cannot name a victim" is not evidence on a shipped surface and that a wrong thing stays. New `triage-duties.md:58` closes a p3 card because no user is measured reaching it. Read with the head of the same bullet (missing `reach:` ⇒ p3), every finding that lacks a measured reach becomes a close candidate, and only the undefined word 「边角」 limits it. Either cite the maintainer's words for this clause and for narrowing ruling B (a comment id on the card is enough, no diff needed for that half), or get the maintainer's answer before this lands; and state in the text which rule wins (for example: the clause applies only after impact grading has already given p3, and never to the shipped surfaces of lines 74–76). Continues no prior id.

S1 (should-fix) — placement and trigger. The standard is a continuation of the bullet 「缺 `reach:` 且非例外 ⇒ 定 p3」 inside the `finding` block, so it reads as a rule for missing-reach findings; the card asks for the first-touch rule for every p3. The sentence 「p3 首触关 not_planned、各写本卡理由:」 has no condition word, so the three items read as a list of reasons, and a p3 card on neither list has no stated outcome. Give the standard its own bullet with an explicit "matches any of" and a default.

S2 (should-fix) — unreconciled neighbours. The PR removed 「不因此关卡」 as contradicting the standard and left three others: `filing-gate.md:26` (no beneficiary ⇒ return to the filer, ⛔ do not close), `filing-gate.md:30` (first-touch close only when none of the four classes fits), `triage-duties.md:84` (first-touch close outside the three classes clears pre-gate stock only). A p3 card with no user effect now meets "return, do not close" and "close" at once. The PR body argues lines 84 and 92 in its Acceptance notes; the rules text does not say it.

S3 (should-fix) — `filing-gate.md:34` cannot be applied without guessing. (a) 「p3 首触关条」 and 「留条」 name a rule in another file without naming the file. (b) 「该 PR 记录」 does not say which record (Acceptance notes, the review record, the dev report) or who writes it when the finder is the L1 seat. (c) The finder alone now judges the close side, the third clause included; after the PR merges or is closed the finding has no carrier and nothing searches PR records (`:37` searches open cards only). That is the intent for no-effect items; it is not shown acceptable for an unmeasured corner, which is M3's subject. (d) The keep side lists security items and line 34 makes the keep side the admission test for two public checklist cards, while `:14` routes every security finding away from this gate; say that line 14 stands. (e) 「下行卡」 has to cover two cards, and the loose-ends card sits on the continuation line after next, whose own wording still reads unconditionally.

N1 (nit) — `triage-duties` old 10: the rule survives in `lanes/cloud.md:27`, but the action is triage's and the triage file no longer points there. Line 9's 「见多仓协调」 is the nearest pointer.

N2 (nit) — `triage-duties` old 57: triage gates class (c) at line 52 with the definition now only in `os-dev.md:50`. Same shape as M2, lower stakes because triage gates and does not measure.

N3 (nit) — the handoff comment 6906241020 states that `execution-duties.md:130` keeps the reader rule for `Suggested-grade:`; it does not (see ①). Correct it when the next head is handed over.

Answers the seat asked for: the `reach:` payer should be swapped (M2); the placement does read as missing-reach only (S1); the ADR bookkeeping cards of `execution-duties.md:112` and `triage-duties.md:75` are ordered by a standing ruling and read as kept under maintainer-directed, no text change owed for them; line 34 and the unchanged loose-ends line agree for published docs and skills text and need S3(e) for the rest.
